power.answer: Kenya Airways' electronic devices page says passengers may use laptops, phones and similar devices only once the aircraft reaches cruise level, after telling the cabin crew. It does not state a power bank rule, so the limits here come from ICAO: two power banks per passenger and no recharging in flight, effective 27 March 2026.

sections.h: 🔋 What Kenya Airways and ICAO say
sections.p: From the Kenya Airways Electronic Devices Information page and the ICAO news release of 27 March 2026, read on 22 November 2026.

rows: Not during taxi-out, take-off, climb, descent, landing and taxi-in; allowed at cruise level after informing cabin crew (Kenya Airways)

Recharging a power bank in flight

list: Not on the page: a watt-hour limit and carry-on or checked rule for power banks. Ask Kenya Airways before you fly.

faq: Can I use my phone at any time on Kenya Airways?
Not during taxi, take-off, climb, descent, landing; at cruise level you may, after telling the cabin crew.
How many power banks on Kenya Airways?
Kenya Airways does not say on the page we read; the ICAO standard from 27 March 2026 limits passengers to two.
sources: Unofficial source: ICAO — New power bank restrictions will safeguard international aviation (27 March 2026)
